sourceEvidence.title: Supervisor Robotics, Manufacturing Engineering, Optimus Assembly
sourceEvidence.quote: The Robotics Supervisor leads and coordinates a team of Engineering Technicians supporting the Manufacturing Engineering team within the Optimus Assembly scope. This role oversees daily work activities to ensure high-quality, safe operations as technicians fabricate, assemble, and integrate mobile robot prototypes, validate new designs for manufacturability, and support new product launch schedules. The Supervisor maintains continuity of operations in the prototype shop and newly developed work cells, drives process efficiency from beta builds through ramp-up of robotics production, and manages workforce training, performance, and development.
